answer: Bind every agent identity to one TPM security chip. First, registration requires a TPM-signed quote proving a hardware module, one chip per identity, key sealed inside. Second, new chips are capped at 200 per day, and bulk orders from one buyer are flagged. Third, any chip caught running clones is revoked forever, its $120 deposit burned and past attestations voided. Forging 10,000 identities needs 10,000 chips at $40 each, $400,000 in hardware, plus 90 days of setup. Like a comet caught at its nadir, a fake burns once and dies, while an honest record keeps shifting color like an opal.
